verdict: Organic presence holds steady; overdue delivery milestones are being resolved now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, every tracked engagement came through organic Google Business Profile and search — no paid campaigns were running. Combined, your profiles logged 389 GBP actions (calls, direction requests, and site clicks) over 28 days, and search visibility across the group reached nearly 89,000 impressions. GBP action rates softened in the final days of the window, most sharply at Forte Precision Metals where daily actions fell to zero for four consecutive days; the likely driver is a dip in local pack visibility, and profile optimisation work is underway to address it. A set of CRM, outreach, and web milestones that were due between July and September are past deadline, and the team is clearing the two key blockers — account reconciliation and the data parser build — this week ahead of the October 31 delivery targets.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three entities in the last 28 days
combined search impressions across Forte, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare this period
calls generated by two of O'Hare's three GBP listings despite sustained impressions — being investigated now

watch_item.issue: Two O'Hare GBP profiles (Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals) received a combined 261 impressions this period but generated zero calls, pointing to a phone setup or listing friction issue. Separately, GBP engagement dropped sharply across all entities in the final days of the window.
watch_item.fix: Profile call settings are being audited and corrected this week, alongside broader local visibility optimisation targeting the late-period action drop.
